s: golokaM

klI, (gOrjyotIrUpaM jyotirmayaH puruza ityarTastasya lokaH sTAnam । aBiDAnAt klIvatvam । yadvA goBiH kiraREH brAhmajYAnatejoBirityarTaH lokyate iti । luk + GaY .) SrIkfzRasya sTAnam । yaTA, tantre । “vEkuRWasya dakzaBAge golokaM sarvvamohanam । tatrEva rADikA devI dviBujo muralIDaraH ॥ yadUpaM golakaM DAma tadrUpaM nAsti mAmake । jYAne vA cakzuzoH kiM vA DyAnayoge na vidyate ॥ SudDatattvamayaM devi ! nAnAdevena SoBitam । maDyadeSe golokAKyaM SrIvizRorloBamandiram ॥ SrIvizRoH sattvarUpasya yat sTalaM cittamohanam । tasya sTAnasya mAhAtmyaM kiM mayA kaTyate'DunA ॥ tatrEza satataM BAti dbiBujo muralIDaraH । tadA sattvamayo vizRurBuvanaM pAti niScitam ॥ dEzRavasya mahAmokzo yatrEva parameSvari ! । iti sTAnasya mAhAtmyaM saMkzepeRa mayoditam ॥ vistAreRa na Saknomi janmAntaraSatena ca । bIjakozasya vAhye tu vezwitaM toyamaRqalam ॥ pramARaM sundaraM toyaM yaTA kzIrodasAgaram । DUmrasya jyotizAkAraM kowicandrasamapraBam ॥ balayAkArarUpeRa suSuBraM toyamaRqalam । gaNgAdisaritaH sarvvAstaTEva BAnti sundari ! ॥ indrAdidevatAH sarvvA stUyamAnA nirantaram । ganDarvvayakzanAgAdikuzmARqA BEravAstaTA ॥ nAnAsuKavilAsena sadA cEkAgracetasaH । vizRugAnaM prakurvvanti stutiBaktiparAyaRAH ॥ devA gAnaM prakurvvanti caturbbaktreRa veDasA । mAlavAdyASca zaqrAgA zawtriMSadrAgiRI taTA ॥ vedagAnena BAsanto mUrttimantaH sadEva hi । mAlavenEva rAgeRa sAmagAnaM sadA priye ॥ mallAreRa sadATarvvaM vasantena taTA punaH ॥ hindolena yajuHpAWaM sadA kurvvanti cetasA ॥ karRAwenEva fgvedaM SrIrAgeRa taTA Sive । nirddizwapAWametattu hyanirddizwamataH param ॥ tatrEva santi te rAgAH sahasrARi ca zoqaSa । sarArermurarIgAnAt srarvvastAlaH prajAyate ॥ tEna tAlena rAgeRa sadA gAyanti veDasaH । tadvAgasya viBAgaM hi kurvvanti munayo janAH ॥ vasantAdyASca fgrapastizWanti tatra santatam । nAnAftuprasUtena BUzitaM murarIDaram ॥ tatrEva rADikA devI nAnAmuKavilAsinI । vadantI murarIgAnaM kuru kAnta ! गोलोमी शतवीर्या च गण्डाली शकुलाक्षका। कुरुविन्दो मेघनामा मुस्ता मुस्तकमस्त्रियाम्.।
गोलोमी भूतकेशो ना पत्राङ्गं रक्तचन्दनम्. त्रिकटु त्र्यूषणं व्योषं त्रिफला तु फलत्रिकम्.।

m: गो—लोमन् n. a cow's hair (from which Dūrvā grass is said to spring), Pāṇ. i, 4, 30; Pat.; Pañcat. i, 1, 81.
